scope: Added sample prompts 06–10 sent sequentially to the existing Render backend before publishing the expanded UI. Generated SQL results compared with independent source-data reference queries; payment chart PNG decoded. Single-run smoke checks, not a reliability benchmark.

cases.question: Return the top 5 customer states by number of customer records. Return state and customer_count, sorted by count descending then state ascending.
cases.sql:
SELECT
  customer_state AS state,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
  olist_customers_dataset
GROUP BY
  customer_state
ORDER BY
  customer_count DESC,
  customer_state ASC
LIMIT 5;

cases.question: What percentage of all orders have order_status = 'delivered'? Return the percentage as a number from 0 to 100.
cases.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM olist_orders_dataset;

cases.question: Return the top 5 product categories by number of order items sold. Join order items to products, exclude missing product categories, return category and item_count, and sort by item_count descending then category ascending.
cases.sql:
SELECT
    p.product_category_name AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM
    olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN
    olist_products_dataset p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
    p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    p.product_category_name
ORDER BY
    item_count DESC,
    category ASC
LIMIT 5;
